A leading provider of Cyber Liability and other innovative specialty solutions, Tokio Marine HCC – Cyber & Professional Lines Group (CPLG) provides insurance and turnkey reinsurance solutions. CPLG is headquartered in Los Angeles, California and issues thousands of policies nationwide annually.

NAS Insurance Services, LLC, was acquired in 2019 by Tokio Marine HCC a rebranded as Tokio Marine HCC – Cyber & Professional Lines Group, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies based in Houston, Texas.
To meet the demand and the fast-paced technological advances among their insurtech competitors, CPLG strategically decided to expand its digital presence.
It began working with ValueMomentum in 2017. At the time, the company was eager to expand distribution, drive innovation, and increase efficiency with its end-to-end policy issuance transformation.

“After having taken time and resources to integrate NAS Insurance with Tokio Marine HCC, we were behind the eight ball to deliver digital solutions to market very quickly,” explains Jamie Kinsley, Deputy COO, CPLG. “ValueMomentum was there for us to provide the talent and expertise we needed to deliver.”
Having established the architectural foundation for the Underwriting Platform, CPLG needed a strategic IT partner to help quickly develop and implement the full solution.

ValueMomentum assisted with:• Adding on world-class digital distribution channels,• Leveraging the rating,• Underwriter rules,• Sophisticated predictive analytics already built into the Underwriting Platform.

CPLG’s Broker Portal and Partner API channels were then combined with the Underwriting Portal to create a sleek, modern platform that uses the latest in technology and security. Brokers now instantly generate quotes and bind them 24/7 on the digital channel of their choice, offering them multiple ways to do business with their clients.

When the relationship began, the desired characteristics ranged from expertise in Agile methodology, building positive, cohesive teams, and a familiarity with the LAMP (Linux, Apache, MySQL, and PHP) stack to using modern application frameworks such as React, Symfony, and Laravel.

Today, Amazon Web Services (AWS) integrations, several complex API integrations, and modern quality assurance (QA) automation and code deployment tools were required to bring the platform into the next generation. “ValueMomentum’s deep, industry-specific experience continues to offer us value,” Kinsley says. “This includes supplying team members who model the engaged, collaborative IT culture we desire, as well as a comprehensive and mature digital and cloud services solution.”
With ValueMomentum as the leading services partner for development and quality assurance, the expanded platform became a reality.
Both the CPLG™ Broker Portal and Partner API aggregator sites rely on the Underwriting Platform as the back end for data, rating, and underwriting rules and servicing kick-out submissions as needed.

With the ability to quickly configure rating updates, CPLG is highly responsive in a competitive market and is incorporating new services and technologies, giving brokers better self-service features while reducing staff workloads, expediting and reducing processing costs, and increasing pricing accuracy.

“To say we’re mutually aligned in our goals only begins to tell the story,” Kinsley says. “Beyond the amazing talent, skills, and expertise each ValueMomentum individual brings to our team, everyone is a good listener, very responsive, and genuinely concerned about us. In short, we wouldn’t be where we are today without ValueMomentum. They have exceeded our highest expectations.”

paragraphs: HomeCase Studies
HomeCase Studies
Insurance, United States
Enabled enterprise and operationswide standardization
Enabled distribution channels for better customer communication and experience
Established an innovative platform for future CCM growth and expansion
Core Platforms

The top-five North American insurer principally serves auto insurance and provides coverage for more than 24 million motor vehicles owned by more than 15 million policy holders. The insurer writes private passenger automobile insurance in all 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia.

The insurer had applications housed on premises with outdated versions of Exstream, and most of them needed an upgrade to meet the rising standards of customer communication. However, these upgrades required hefty costs and time, while also needing to be done every two years. In addition, the insurer’s existing CCM relied on a complex legacy system of real time, interactive and batch applications that failed to efficiently handle an increasingly large volume of letters. This further hindered accurate and active communication with customers as well as underwriting speed.

The insurer decided that the best way to cut costs and drive operational efficiency was to transition from their on-premises system to a cloudbased CCM solution. Because their existing platform on Exstream was not offering Cloud SaaS models, they needed to purchase a cloud-based modern and flexible CCM platform that could help streamline communication processes, improve consistency, and operate independently without continuous intervention from the insurer. As a short-term solution, the insurer decided to upgrade to the latest version of Exstream (V16.6). Then, they chose VM as a partner to help select a Cloud CCM product and migrate all active forms to the cloud in recordbreaking time. This long-term Cloud solution would cut further software maintenance costs and upgrade delays in areas Exstream was not offering.

Since ValueMomentum had been a CCM IT services partner to this insurer for more than 10 years, VM was able to easily align on business objectives and help the insurer build and configure enterprise-wide architecture to support CCM engagements on OpenText Exstream and SmartCOMM. SmartCOMM was identified as the most economical Cloud solution, as the licensing cost for it was less when compared with OpenText Exstream in a multi-year contract (5 years).

VM helped the insurer upgrade to the latest version of Exstream within a short time without compromising on the quality. Using real time, interactive and batch delivery models, VM designed and developed more than 120 applications across multiple LOBs like Personal Lines, Commercial Lines, Claims, Umbrella and Billing portfolios etc. in Exstream. In addition, VM helped the insurer transition from using interactive and live editors on premises to browser-based editors.

After upgrading Exstream, VM helped leverage high value SaaS solutions through SmartCOMM to fully pave the insurer’s full transition to the cloud. Using automation and accelerators, VM provided end-to-end design flow to migrate around 4,800 active forms, including complicated, interactive-driven underwriting and billing applications. This included initiating and implementing on-demand and ad hoc Standalone applications to accommodate various digital communications requests (e.g., paper suppression, email). Without compromising on the quality and compliance, VM worked with the insurer’s upstream and downstream systems to meet their goals in record time.

With this up-to-date, cloud-based CCM solution, the insurer will be able to deliver personalized communications management and increase customer satisfaction. Their new integrations provide customers with the ability to choose distribution channels to receive their policy and billing information. Interactive forms on SmartComm provide easily reproducible and customizable messaging for underwriters to utilize as well, cutting manual edits and improving operational efficiency. The SmartComm solution replaces various small third-party licensed tools and in-house applications and allows CCM to function under a simplified central platform. This ultimately helps the insurer standardize and regulate content across channels with speed and quality while cutting maintenance and upgrade costs.

Insurance, United States

Faster forms implementation via modified forms architecture

Core Platforms

Headquartered on the West Coast, this usage-based insurer offers personalized pricing based on vehicle data in the Midwest region of the United States. As part of a navigation and location-based services company, and underwritten by a national personal lines carrier, the insurer offers value-added services, such as route and safety suggestions, as well as rewards for safe driving scores through apps and in-vehicle infotainment systems. Its business model includes agency and direct-toconsumer distribution, straight-through processing, and all-electronic submissions and document delivery.

The client, a small greenfield insurer, knew that to build up its customer base and expand its opportunities for growth, it needed to roll out its offerings to a more extensive geographical area. With this goal in mind, the insurer decided to roll out in all 50 states.

But in order to achieve its ambitious expansion plans, the insurer wanted to develop a repeatable strategy to simplify and accelerate rollouts to multiple states in parallel while taking into account the specific requirements for each state. The carrier decided to take a phased approach by initially rolling out in four new states in the Midwest.

The insurer had previously implemented Duck Creek OnDemand’s Policy, Billing, and Insights for a single state, but its team was dealing with application instability, especially with the billing platform.

In addition to seeking to define a rollout strategy, the insurer also wanted to shore up its internal team to be able to support its Duck Creek applications, especially Billing. Without internal resources skilled in these platforms, there was no one on hand to train their team. The carrier also needed input on how best to incorporate an external rating engine, how to conduct effective quality assurance on its systems, and how best to maintain and support its technology infrastructure while embarking on its growth goals.

The carrier, which had worked with ValueMomentum previously for managed services, once again turned to ValueMomentum to develop a multi-state expansion strategy based on its Duck Creek State Rollout Framework. These goals included moving each of four new states into production within months and developing a repeatable multi-state strategy to achieve nationwide coverage.

A cross-functional ValueMomentum team, including on-site and offshore members, brought together business analysts, a Duck Creek Policy architect, multiple developers, a quality analyst, and a project manager. Within three months, the teams designed the system architecture, rolled out the four new states (three in parallel) plus renewal automation, and helped integrate an external proprietary rating engine in one, per the client’s preference, replacing Duck Creek’s native rating system.

Leveraging its Duck Creek State Rollout Framework, ValueMomentum helped the insurer consolidate business requirements, identify commonalities and differences in state regulations, and create an internal structure and architecture to support base and identity deviations from state to state. This enabled the insurer to implement several states simultaneously and reduced implementation time to as little as three months. In addition, ValueMomentum provided consulting and design for optimizing the parallel implementation and maintenance processes, including an internal knowledge base for rules, rates, differences, and other domain knowledge.

The client successfully rolled out in four additional states with minimal delays or issues during the project. The newly developed process allowed the carrier to maintain parallel development and release, allowing the organization to ensure rapid time to production across parallel releases. With ValueMomentum’s input, the insurer was able to account for statespecific requirements.

The modified forms architecture and automated renewal logic have made forms implementation and renewals processing for new states significantly quicker. Furthermore, consolidating the business requirements for all 50 states and enabling the system to identify and compare differences and similarities will expedite future state rollouts and support continuing growth.

CLIENT OVERVIEW
Headquartered on the West Coast, this usage-based insurer offers personalized pricing based on vehicle data in the Midwest region of the United States. As part of a navigation and location-based services company, and underwritten by a national personal lines carrier, the insurer offers value-added services, such as route and safety suggestions, as well as rewards for safe driving scores through apps and in-vehicle infotainment systems. Its business model includes agency and direct-toconsumer distribution, straight-through processing, and all-electronic submissions and document delivery.
BUSINESS CHALLENGE
The client, a small greenfield insurer, knew that to build up its customer base and expand its opportunities for growth, it needed to roll out its offerings to a more extensive geographical area. With this goal in mind, the insurer decided to roll out in all 50 states.
But in order to achieve its ambitious expansion plans, the insurer wanted to develop a repeatable strategy to simplify and accelerate rollouts to multiple states in parallel while taking into account the specific requirements for each state. The carrier decided to take a phased approach by initially rolling out in four new states in the Midwest.
The insurer had previously implemented Duck Creek OnDemand’s Policy, Billing, and Insights for a single state, but its team was dealing with application instability, especially with the billing platform.
In addition to seeking to define a rollout strategy, the insurer also wanted to shore up its internal team to be able to support its Duck Creek applications, especially Billing. Without internal resources skilled in these platforms, there was no one on hand to train their team. The carrier also needed input on how best to incorporate an external rating engine, how to conduct effective quality assurance on its systems, and how best to maintain and support its technology infrastructure while embarking on its growth goals.
SOLUTION OFFERED
The carrier, which had worked with ValueMomentum previously for managed services, once again turned to ValueMomentum to develop a multi-state expansion strategy based on its Duck Creek State Rollout Framework. These goals included moving each of four new states into production within months and developing a repeatable multi-state strategy to achieve nationwide coverage.
A cross-functional ValueMomentum team, including on-site and offshore members, brought together business analysts, a Duck Creek Policy architect, multiple developers, a quality analyst, and a project manager. Within three months, the teams designed the system architecture, rolled out the four new states (three in parallel) plus renewal automation, and helped integrate an external proprietary rating engine in one, per the client’s preference, replacing Duck Creek’s native rating system.
Leveraging its Duck Creek State Rollout Framework, ValueMomentum helped the insurer consolidate business requirements, identify commonalities and differences in state regulations, and create an internal structure and architecture to support base and identity deviations from state to state. This enabled the insurer to implement several states simultaneously and reduced implementation time to as little as three months. In addition, ValueMomentum provided consulting and design for optimizing the parallel implementation and maintenance processes, including an internal knowledge base for rules, rates, differences, and other domain knowledge.
The newly developed process allowed the carrier to maintain parallel development and release, allowing the organization to ensure rapid time to production across parallel releases.
VALUE DELIVERED
The client successfully rolled out in four additional states with minimal delays or issues during the project. The newly developed process allowed the carrier to maintain parallel development and release, allowing the organization to ensure rapid time to production across parallel releases. With ValueMomentum’s input, the insurer was able to account for statespecific requirements.
The modified forms architecture and automated renewal logic have made forms implementation and renewals processing for new states significantly quicker. Furthermore, consolidating the business requirements for all 50 states and enabling the system to identify and compare differences and similarities will expedite future state rollouts and support continuing growth.
Requirement walkthroughs and sprint planning sessions were found to be effective in preventing defects and ensuring clarity on sprint scope. Proactive communication and collaboration with stakeholders led to better understanding, reduced rework, and improved overall quality.
In addition, ValueMomentum helped the customer become self-sufficient at reducing newer implementations’ defects and incidents. On top of smoother rollouts, the insurer was able to build its own in-house team to maintain its Duck Creek Billing product effectively.

paragraphs: HomeCompanyCorporate Social Responsibility

At ValueMomentum, social responsibility is an integral component of our core values. Our social responsibility initiatives are not just impactful, they are strategic. We invest in initiatives that create a stronger and more sustainable future for generations to come.

Our CSR initiatives focus on improving access to STEAM education, primary healthcare facilities, and skilled healthcare personnel in urban, semi-urban, and rural areas. To address these needs, ValueMomentum designed its SHEE Program (STEAM education, Healthcare, Environmental sustainability, and Entrepreneurship) to help the communities we live in.
Initiatives to improve STEAM access

We believe that STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Maths) education unlocks world of opportunities for well-paying jobs and enables upward social mobility. To support access to STEAM education, we are supporting deserving schools and other educational organizations with grants.
Collaborations for enhancing healthcare

Through partnerships with non-profit organizations, we are improving access to healthcare in rural and semi-urban areas. This enables us to offer primary care and testing, and in limited cases, even specialty healthcare. With their support, we’ve already established two primary care centers.
Initiatives for environmental harmony

We recognize the need for environmental sustainability and continuously optimize our operations for reducing greenhouse gas emissions as well as energy and water consumption. We also supports organizations that are working hard for lake preservation, tree plantation, and soil conservation.
Grants for community empowerment

Combining our values of entrepreneurship and contributing to the communities we operate in, we established entrepreneurship CSR grants. These grants empower doctors to set up clinics and provide them with guidance to ensure their financial viability.
Empowering communities through WhiteCoats clinics

A major accomplishment under the SHEE program in 2023 was the establishment of two primary healthcare centers, named WhiteCoats Family Clinic, in Qutbullapur and Tumukunta, Telangana, India. These clinics are making a tangible difference in the lives of the underserved populations in these areas.
HomeCompanyCorporate Social Responsibility

Finding the balance between short-term demands and long-term sustainability requires a collective effort from all voices within our company. We believe that top-down CSR initiatives can be counterproductive. Instead, we embrace a representative approach, led by committees.

We allocate 3% of our company’s profits to committee-led initiatives, ensuring agile responses to pressing needs. Prioritization is guided by committee recommendations, ensuring impactful and inclusive CSR efforts.
GM Raju (“Raj”) Samanthapudi
Founder &Executive Chairman
Ravi S. Rao
Managing Director &Location Head
Uma Gogineni
EDUCATION

In partnership with Nirmaan Organization, ValueMomentum distributed back-to-school kits to 1,181 girl students across our adopted KGBV schools in Kondapur, Kandukur, and Hathnoora. Each student received a school bag, notebooks, and essential stationery, equipping them with the resources they need to begin the new academic year with confidence.

This initiative is part of our ongoing commitment to supporting these schools through improved infrastructure, learning resources, and holistic development, helping create an environment where every student has the opportunity to learn and thrive.
EDUCATION

In partnership with Nirmaan Organization, we completed a set of major infrastructure upgrades at KGBV Hathnoora, covering building renovation and repairs, dormitory and campus development works, safety enhancements, and learning support facilities — strengthening the overall campus environment for over 220 girl students. A STEM lab with a trained instructor was also established, along with furniture and sports equipment support to encourage innovation, academic engagement, and holistic development.

In partnership with Nirmaan, we established two WhiteCoats Clinics in Thumkunta and Quthbullapur, offering essential healthcare to underserved communities in Hyderabad. Serving over 6,000 people, these clinics provide primary care, diagnostics, medicines, and specialized services, with a focus on building an anaemia-free community.

paragraphs: HomeCelonis

ValueMomentum combines Celonis’s Process Intelligence Platform with deep claims domain expertise to reveal hidden leakage, quantify operational friction, and build the business case for transformation.
Our Partnership

Most claims organizations know they have operational friction — long cycle times, inconsistent handling, reserve leakage — but struggle to pinpoint exactly where value is lost and why. ValueMomentum integrates Celonis Process Intelligence into our Claims Diagnostic Assessment methodology, creating an evidence-based foundation for transformation.

Where traditional diagnostics rely on interviews, file reviews, and sample-based audits, Celonis enables us to mine actual system event logs from platforms like Guidewire ClaimCenter, generating a complete, data-driven picture of how claims actually flow through an organization, across every adjuster, every line of business, and every exception path.
Together, we help P&C insurers:
Assets and Accelerators
ValueMomentum’s proprietary diagnostic assets are purpose-built for P&C claims and enhanced by Celonis process mining to deliver faster, more precise assessments.

A comprehensive benchmarking engine evaluating claims performance across cost, experience, productivity, and effectiveness dimensions. When paired with Celonis event log analysis, the tool moves beyond self-reported maturity scores to validated, data-driven process assessments across claims processes.

Three-tier maturity benchmarks (Basic, Intermediate, Best-in-Class) mapped to each claims subprocess. Celonis process mining output is scored directly against these benchmarks, creating an objective maturity baseline that replaces subjective interview-based assessments.

A structured leakage classification framework that maps process breakdowns to financial impact across indemnity, LAE, and recovery dimensions. Celonis process mining feeds directly into this taxonomy, enabling carrier-specific leakage quantification rather than industry-average estimates.

Proprietary audit questionnaires across auto, property, specialty, and workers’ compensation lines. Celonis findings direct file review sampling toward process areas with the highest detected variance, making file reviews targeted rather than random.
What We Do: Offerings and Services
Claims Diagnostic Assessment (Celonis-Enhanced)

Our flagship diagnostic offering, now accelerated with Celonis process mining. We extract event logs from your claims platform, map actual process flows against our proprietary maturity benchmarks, and deliver a quantified view of leakage, efficiency gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Claims Leakage Analysis

A targeted assessment focused on identifying and quantifying controllable indemnity and LAE leakage. Celonis process mining identifies the specific workflow deviations, timing gaps, and handoff failures that create leakage; enabling root-cause analysis at a depth traditional file reviews cannot achieve alone.
Claims Quality Assurance Program Design

Design and implement QA programs that evolve from periodic, sample-based audits to continuous, data-driven process monitoring. Celonis provides the always-on conformance layer, while ValueMomentum’s claims expertise defines what “good” looks like across each line of business.
Claims Transformation Roadmap and Implementation

From diagnostic findings to execution. We translate Celonis-powered insights into prioritized transformation roadmaps spanning people, process, and technology; and stay engaged through implementation to ensure value realization.
Claims Operations Benchmarking

Leverage ValueMomentum’s benchmarking database (built from assessments across 75+ US carriers) combined with Celonis process intelligence to provide the most comprehensive view of where your claims organization stands relative to peers and best-in-class performers.

paragraphs: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, the types of cookies we use (i.e., the information we collect using cookies and how that information is used), and how to manage your cookie settings.

Cookies are small text files used to store small pieces of information. They are stored on your device when a website loads in your browser. These cookies help ensure that the website functions properly, enhance security, provide a better user experience, and analyse performance to identify what works and where improvements are needed.

Like most online services, our website uses both first-party and third-party cookies for various purposes. First-party cookies are primarily necessary for the website to function properly and do not collect any personally identifiable data.

The third-party cookies used on our website primarily help us understand how the website performs, track how you interact with it, keep our services secure, deliver relevant advertisements, and enhance your overall user experience while improving the speed of your future interactions with our website.
Necessary

Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, such as providing secure log-in or adjusting your consent preferences. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.
Functional
Functional cookies help perform certain functionalities like sharing the content of the website on social media platforms, collecting feedback, and other third-party features.
Analytics
Analytical cookies are used to understand how visitors interact with the website. These cookies help provide information on metrics such as the number of visitors, bounce rate, traffic source, etc.
Advertisement
Advertisement cookies are used to provide visitors with customised advertisements based on the pages you visited previously and to analyse the effectiveness of the ad campaigns.
Uncategorised
Other uncategorised cookies are those that are being analysed and have not been classified into a category as yet.

By continuing to use our website, you acknowledge and agree to our Cookie Policy and the use of cookies. Different browsers offer various methods to block and delete cookies used by websites. title: Corporate Social Responsibility - ValueMomentum
meta_description: Caring for Our Communities At ValueMomentum, social responsibility is an integral component of our core values. Our social responsibility initiatives are
paragraphs: HomeCompanyCorporate Social Responsibility

At ValueMomentum, social responsibility is an integral component of our core values. Our social responsibility initiatives are not just impactful, they are strategic. We invest in initiatives that create a stronger and more sustainable future for generations to come.

Our CSR initiatives focus on improving access to STEAM education, primary healthcare facilities, and skilled healthcare personnel in urban, semi-urban, and rural areas. To address these needs, ValueMomentum designed its SHEE Program (STEAM education, Healthcare, Environmental sustainability, and Entrepreneurship) to help the communities we live in.
Initiatives to improve STEAM access

We believe that STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Maths) education unlocks world of opportunities for well-paying jobs and enables upward social mobility. To support access to STEAM education, we are supporting deserving schools and other educational organizations with grants.
Collaborations for enhancing healthcare

Through partnerships with non-profit organizations, we are improving access to healthcare in rural and semi-urban areas. This enables us to offer primary care and testing, and in limited cases, even specialty healthcare. With their support, we’ve already established two primary care centers.
Initiatives for environmental harmony

We recognize the need for environmental sustainability and continuously optimize our operations for reducing greenhouse gas emissions as well as energy and water consumption. We also supports organizations that are working hard for lake preservation, tree plantation, and soil conservation.
Grants for community empowerment

Combining our values of entrepreneurship and contributing to the communities we operate in, we established entrepreneurship CSR grants. These grants empower doctors to set up clinics and provide them with guidance to ensure their financial viability.
Empowering communities through WhiteCoats clinics

A major accomplishment under the SHEE program in 2023 was the establishment of two primary healthcare centers, named WhiteCoats Family Clinic, in Qutbullapur and Tumukunta, Telangana, India. These clinics are making a tangible difference in the lives of the underserved populations in these areas.
HomeCompanyCorporate Social Responsibility

Finding the balance between short-term demands and long-term sustainability requires a collective effort from all voices within our company. We believe that top-down CSR initiatives can be counterproductive. Instead, we embrace a representative approach, led by committees.

We allocate 3% of our company’s profits to committee-led initiatives, ensuring agile responses to pressing needs. Prioritization is guided by committee recommendations, ensuring impactful and inclusive CSR efforts.
GM Raju (“Raj”) Samanthapudi

Caring for Our Communities
At ValueMomentum, social responsibility is an integral component of our core values. Our social responsibility initiatives are not just impactful, they are strategic. We invest in initiatives that create a stronger and more sustainable future for generations to come.
Watch video to learn more
SHEE Social Responsibility Program
Our CSR initiatives focus on improving access to STEAM education, primary healthcare facilities, and skilled healthcare personnel in urban, semi-urban, and rural areas. To address these needs, ValueMomentum designed its SHEE Program (STEAM education, Healthcare, Environmental sustainability, and Entrepreneurship) to help the communities we live in.
Education
Initiatives to improve STEAM access
We believe that STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Maths) education unlocks world of opportunities for well-paying jobs and enables upward social mobility. To support access to STEAM education, we are supporting deserving schools and other educational organizations with grants.
Healthcare
Collaborations for enhancing healthcare
Through partnerships with non-profit organizations, we are improving access to healthcare in rural and semi-urban areas. This enables us to offer primary care and testing, and in limited cases, even specialty healthcare. With their support, we’ve already established two primary care centers.
Sustainability
Initiatives for environmental harmony
We recognize the need for environmental sustainability and continuously optimize our operations for reducing greenhouse gas emissions as well as energy and water consumption. We also supports organizations that are working hard for lake preservation, tree plantation, and soil conservation.
Entrepreneurship
Grants for community empowerment
Combining our values of entrepreneurship and contributing to the communities we operate in, we established entrepreneurship CSR grants. These grants empower doctors to set up clinics and provide them with guidance to ensure their financial viability.
Empowering communities through WhiteCoats clinics
Empowering communities through WhiteCoats clinics
A major accomplishment under the SHEE program in 2023 was the establishment of two primary healthcare centers, named WhiteCoats Family Clinic, in Qutbullapur and Tumukunta, Telangana, India. These clinics are making a tangible difference in the lives of the underserved populations in these areas.

Our CSR philosophy
Finding the balance between short-term demands and long-term sustainability requires a collective effort from all voices within our company. We believe that top-down CSR initiatives can be counterproductive. Instead, we embrace a representative approach, led by committees.
We allocate 3% of our company’s profits to committee-led initiatives, ensuring agile responses to pressing needs. Prioritization is guided by committee recommendations, ensuring impactful and inclusive CSR efforts.

ValueMomentum Named Leader and CX Star Performer in ISG Provider Lens® – Global Insurance ITO Services 2026

paragraphs: HomeNews CenterPress ReleasesAcuity Modernizes Customer Communications Management with OpenText Exstream and ValueMomentum
Related
Piscataway, NJ

ValueMomentum, Inc., a provider of software and services to insurance, healthcare and financial services firms, announced today that Acuity, a mid-west insurance carrier of innovative property & casualty offerings covering personal and commercial lines, has achieved a significant milestone in its initiative to modernize customer correspondence forms using OpenText Exstream’s Empower Editor and ValueMomentum’s customer communications management services.

Acuity was still reliant on some legacy technologies and processes. To continue meeting its growth and customer experience targets, Acuity’s leadership established a range of strategic modernization and digitization goals, which included modernizing its customer-facing correspondence and legacy form-generation tools.

Having selected OpenText Exstream as the company’s modern customer communications platform, Acuity sought to engage ValueMomentum for its expertise with Exstream and in agile methodologies. Over the course of 10 sprints, ValueMomentum assisted Acuity with rationalizing and converting over 1,100 forms to Exstream’s Empower Editor, addressing the needs of claims, billing, loss control, marketing, premium audit and customer service across personal and commercial lines.

“Quantitatively, the project achieved impressive results,” said Marcus Knuth, Vice President, Enterprise Technology at Acuity. “We’ve reduced the volume of forms by 28%.  Additionally, we expect annual savings of 70,000 business user hours once form data fill, system-generated submission, and centralized printing is complete.”

“The insurance industry has great potential to optimize their customer communications management processes to provide their customers and agents with rich and engaging digital experiences,” said Patricia Nagle, SVP CMO, OpenText. “The results Acuity achieved by leveraging Exstream are tremendous, and we are proud of the value we were able to deliver together. As a partner, ValueMomentum has demonstrated their ability to deliver results and modernize a wide range of business correspondence based on OpenText Exstream.”

“We are thrilled to have had the privilege of partnering with Acuity’s top-notch team and enabling their goals of delivering multi-channel customer communications,” says James Carlucci, Senior Vice President at ValueMomentum, adding “Our partnership with OpenText Exstream enables us to support our insurers’ goals of transforming to digital enterprises”.

ValueMomentum provides software and services to Insurance, Healthcare & Financial Services firms. Customers choose ValueMomentum due to the company’s track record of delivering value and driving the momentum of customers’ business initiatives. ValueMomentum accomplishes this by applying a time-tested formula of combining strong technology expertise with deep industry experience. For more information, visithttps://www.valuemomentum.com.

Piscataway, NJ

ValueMomentum, Inc., a provider of software and services to the insurance, healthcare and financial services industries, announced today that Convelo Insurance Group (Convelo) has selected ValueMomentum’s iFoundry Rating Engine along with BizDynamics for enabling rating & quoting for commercial lines. Convelo’s E&S rating requirements based from ISO lines, which will leverage ISO Electronic Rating ContentTM(ERC). Convelo is a new and exciting Managing General Agent (MGA) start-up, which began operations mid-2017.

Convelo is starting with Contractors General Liability for their initial Commercial Lines release. From there, they will quickly roll-out Transportation/Inland Marine, Property, Commercial Package; Personal Lines Home Owners, Auto, Personal Package, Flood, and other specialized programs that meets the needs of their customers, brokers, and agents. Product and Program innovation which aligns to the objectives of their carriers, coupled with the capabilities of the technical platform, will enable Convelo to swiftly be recognized as a serious differentiator.

“We are to provide a zero to low touch speed to market digital customer experience”, explains Salvatore V. Abano, EVP & CIO of Convelo.  “We are rapidly executing against our plan to establish systems, distribution and establish partnerships with more carriers. Our entire business model is about the way we connect electronically to our various methods of conventional and non-conventional distribution channels. We found ValueMomentum’s solution as a good fit to rapidly roll out new products and support our digital technology strategy by leveraging their rating software along with ISO Electronic Rating ContentTM.”

“Convelo recognizes the importance of digital technology as a lever to achieve its business goals”, said Abhijeet Jhaveri, Chief Marketing Officer of ValueMomentum. “We are excited to partner with Convelo in their journey”.

BOSTON, MA., May 28, 2025–Earnix, a leading global provider of intelligent decisioning Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions for regulated industries, and ValueMomentum, a global services and solutions provider exclusively focused on property and casualty (P&C) insurance, today announced a partnership to help P&C insurers drive greater results across rating and underwriting. The partnership combines Earnix’s modern SaaS solution for pricing, rating, and underwriting with ValueMomentum’s deep knowledge of the product and underwriting life cycle to help insurers yield accurate, high-value outcomes.

While the P&C insurance industry in the US saw improvements in 2024 overthe $24.6 billion underwriting loss of 2023, better risk selection, pricing, and underwriting are more crucial than ever for insurers to drive profitable growth in 2025 and beyond. This new partnership will help insurers be certain that their rating and underwriting decisioning is poised for success.

“We are excited to partner with ValueMomentum, leveraging their industry expertise alongside our advanced decision-making capabilities,” said Ruth Fisk, Head of Business Development, Earnix. “Together, we will enhance underwriting and pricing outcomes for P&C insurers, driving profitable growth in a competitive market.”

Earnix’s unified underwriting and pricing platform allows for accelerated, insights-fueled decision-making. With ValueMomentum’s insurance industry and technology expertise, insurers can feel confident that their entire underwriting life cycle is meeting industry-leading standards.

“We’re thrilled to be partnering with Earnix to better serve our customers’ needs across the product, pricing, and underwriting cycle,” said Rajesh Narayan, VP of Product and Underwriting at ValueMomentum. “Earnix’s industry-leading capabilities paired with ValueMomentum’s experience over 25 years helping P&C insurers revitalize their product development, actuarial, and underwriting processes will be a winning combination for our clients.”
To learn more about how Earnix and ValueMomentum work together,click here.
About Earnix

Earnix is the premier provider of mission-critical, cloud-based intelligent decisioning across pricing, underwriting, rating, and product personalization. Its fully integrated platform provides ultra-fast ROI and is designed to transform how global insurers and banks are run by unlocking value across all facets of the business. Earnix has been innovating for insurers and banks since 2001, with customers in over 35 countries across six continents and offices in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Israel. Having served over 100 insurers, ValueMomentum is one of the largest services providers exclusively focused on the insurance industry. For more information, visithttps://www.valuemomentum.com.

Related
Hyderabad, AP, India

FICO (NYSE:FICO), the leading provider of analytics and decision management technology, and ValueMomentum will jointly host a roundtable for Indian insurance carriers on 30 August, 2012 at Mumbai, India.

The “Winning Against Insurance Fraud Roundtable” will focus on how predictive analytics helps uncover new fraud, waste and abuse using a data-driven approach, as well as on fraud detection techniques using predictive analytics solutions from FICO and FICO® Blaze Advisor® business rules management system .

As the insurance industry worldwide strives to grow despite a dynamic economic climate, insurers are focused on achieving operational efficiency across their organization while balancing profitable growth. FICO’s advanced suite of technologies, applications, and services provides insurers with sharper insights into customer risk and behavior, then facilitates rapidly moving these insights into operational decision making. FICO’s solutions maximize efficiencies across core business processes and increase precision in a host of customer decisions that can trigger profitable growth.

FICO Blaze Advisor is the world’s leading business rules management system, maximizing control over high volume operational decisions. It provides companies across industries with a scalable solution that delivers unprecedented agility, consistency and business control. FICO Blaze Advisor is widely used in the insurance industry worldwide, and is also the rules engine within FICO’s industry-leading applications for decision management.

ValueMomentum holds the distinction of having successfully aided several Indian and international insurance carriers in implementing high-impact decision systems such as Automated Underwriting, Rating Segmentation, Claims Adjudication, Personalization, amongst others. ValueMomentum has deep expertise in inference-based Business Rule Engines like FICO® Blaze Advisor® business rules management system, and other decision-intensive technologies such as product configuration and pricing.

Founded in 1956, FICO provides industry-leading solutions for managing credit accounts, identifying and minimizing the impact of fraud, and customizing consumer offers with pinpoint accuracy. Most of the world’s top banks as well as leading insurers, including those in India and Asia Pacific, rely on FICO solutions to accelerate growth, control risk, boost profits and meet regulatory and competitive demands.
For more information on the event, please visit the event microsite: About the Sessions, About the Speakers.
About FICO

FICO (NYSE:FICO), formerly known as Fair Isaac, delivers superior predictive analytics solutions that drive smarter decisions. The company’s groundbreaking use of mathematics to predict consumer behavior has transformed entire industries and revolutionized the way risk is managed and products are marketed. FICO’s innovative solutions include the industry-leading solutions for measuring credit risk, managing credit accounts, identifying and minimizing the impact of fraud, and customizing consumer offers with pinpoint accuracy. Most of the world’s top banks, as well as leading insurers, retailers, pharmaceutical companies and government agencies, rely on FICO solutions to accelerate growth, control risk, boost profits and meet regulatory and competitive demands.
FICO: Make every decision count™.For FICO news and media resources, visitwww.fico.com/news.

ValueMomentum offerings selected by Frederick Mutual include BizDynamics Digital Solution and iFoundry Rating Engine, which fully automates ISO Electronic Rating Content (ERC), allowing Frederick Mutual to launch and maintain rating for its lines of business.

Referring to itself as a “174-year-old start-up,” Frederick Mutual’s vision is to leverage ValueMomentum solutions to transform its operation from a regional mutual insurance provider to a progressive and modern organization able to easily and aggressively expand within its current geographic markets and into additional markets with new personal and commercial lines product offerings.

“Providing our agents with competitive products is an important step in our transformation” says Nancy Newmister, president and CEO of Frederick Mutual Insurance Company. “Working with ValueMomentum and ISO affords us the ability to quickly adjust to changing market conditions and new opportunities.”

We look forward to building on the trust Nancy has laid on ValueMomentum as we continue onto delivering new products and an omni-channel experience to agents, customers and employees” said Swarup Ghosh, chief delivery & services officer at ValueMomentum.  “We’re pleased that Frederick Mutual is working with ValueMomentum, an important ISO ERC vendor-partner,” said Mark Sheehan, vice president of ISO Rating Solutions. “We look forward to collaborating with ValueMomentum and helping Frederick Mutual pursue its plans to grow and expand into new markets.”

PISCATAWAY, N.J. and SAN MATEO, Calif., June 4, 2025– ValueMomentum, a leading services and solutions provider exclusively focused on supporting property and casualty (P&C) insurers, and Guidewire (NYSE: GWRE) congratulate Farm Bureau Insurance Company of Idaho on the successful upgrade of GuidewireInsuranceSuitetoGuidewire CloudPlatform. ValueMomentum, a Guidewire PartnerConnect Consultingpartner at the Select level, was the lead partner in the implementation project.

The migration from an on-premises deployment to Guidewire Cloud Platform was stewarded by Farm Bureau Insurance Company of Idaho’s Information Systems department and was completed in under 12 months. Leveraging InsuranceSuite on Guidewire Cloud Platform allows the company to provide a modern user experience to customers, partners, and employees; accelerate speed to market; and enable the business agility needed to navigate future market changes.

“The successful Guidewire Cloud project has modernized our systems and infrastructure,” said Todd Argall, President and CEO of Farm Bureau Insurance Company of Idaho. “It provides a strong foundation for delivering best-in-class products and services to our customers and leveraging Guidewire’s latest innovations. This important milestone was achieved in a timely manner through the skillful and collaborative work of both the Farm Bureau team and ValueMomentum.”

“Bringing new products to market quickly is critical for us, and completing this project is a major achievement,” said Shilynn Francisco, Vice President of Information Systems at Farm Bureau Insurance Company of Idaho. “We’re excited to leverage the innovative tools of the cloud platform. ValueMomentum was a trusted partner throughout the process — bringing creative solutions to complex challenges and helping us deliver our Guidewire Cloud migration with confidence.”

“We admire Farm Bureau Insurance Company of Idaho’s 78 years of service in providing financial peace of mind to Idaho and Washington families, farms, and businesses by protecting what matters most,” commented Guidewire Head of Professional Services Michael Mahoney. “We are honored that Guidewire Cloud Platform is serving as the technology foundation for the company’s continued growth and success.”

ValueMomentum President Abhijeet Jhaveri stated, “We congratulate Farm Bureau Insurance Company of Idaho for the successful migration of Guidewire InsuranceSuite to Guidewire Cloud Platform. We look forward to our continued collaboration and leveraging new functionality from Guidewire and its ecosystem to provide enhanced protection and services to policyholders.”
About Farm Bureau Insurance Company of Idaho

Since its founding by Idaho farmers and ranchers in 1947, Farm Bureau Insurance Company of Idaho has helped provide peace of mind to Idaho families, farms, and businesses by protecting what matters most.

Staying true to this mission for more than 78 years, the company has grown into the largest property-casualty insurer headquartered in Idaho and ranks in the top three in overall premium among property-casualty insurers in the state. In 2023, Farm Bureau Insurance Company of Idaho expanded into Washington state under the name Western Community Insurance to bring its decades of experience to the broader Northwest community.

In 2025, the company was ranked #3 statewide and #5 in East Idaho on the prestigious list of the Best Places to Work in Idaho. Additionally, AM Best cited Farm Bureau Insurance’s improved underwriting and operating performance as the reason behind its 2023 Financial Strength Rating upgrade from A- (Excellent) to A (Excellent).
For more information, visitwww.idahofarmbureauinsurance.com.
About Guidewire Software

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. More than 570 insurers in 42 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, rely on Guidewire products. With core systems leveraging data and analytics, digital, and artificial intelligence, Guidewire defines cloud platform excellence for P&C insurers.

We are proud of our unparalleled implementation record, with 1,700+ successful projects supported by the industry’s largest R&D team and SI partner ecosystem. Our marketplace represents the largest solution partner community in P&C, where customers can access hundreds of applications to accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
For more information, please visitwww.guidewire.comand follow us onX(formerly known as Twitter) andLinkedIn.
About ValueMomentum

ValueMomentum is a leading solutions provider for the global property and casualty insurance industry. The company helps insurers stay ahead with sustained growth and high performance, enhancing stakeholder value and fostering resilient societies. Having served over 100 insurers, ValueMomentum is one of the largest services providers exclusively focused on the insurance industry. For more information, visithttps://www.valuemomentum.com.

ValueMomentum, Inc., a provider of software and services to insurance carriers, announced today that James (Jim) Carlucci has joined the firm to further develop its growing Insurance business. In his new position as ValueMomentum’s Vice President, Insurance, Jim will augment the leadership team to spearhead the company’s Insurance business growth and championing solutions to improve carriers’ front office operations.

Jim brings a wealth of experience within the Insurance Industry, having held various business leadership positions at Erie Insurance, a Fortune 500 company, over the past 30 years. Prior to joining ValueMomentum, Jim most recently held the position of Vice President, Strategic and Integrated Services, with duties spanning enterprise architecture, project management office, quality assurance, IT security, and technical writing. Prior to this role, Jim held progressively broader IT leadership roles developing IT Strategy, serving as overall Delivery Officer with corresponding PMO responsibilities, and functional oversight for Project Management, Business Analysis, Solution Architecture, Software Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Technical Communications.

“ValueMomentum has a portfolio of offerings and an exceptional track record of customer service that position itself as an innovative provider of software and services to improve carriers’ front office operations. I am proud to be associated with ValueMomentum and look forward to being a part of a team committed to deliver exceptional value to insurance carriers,” said Jim, adding, “I am extremely impressed with the commitment and expertise ValueMomentum offers insurance carriers to successfully deliver value to their initiatives, in a predictable manner.”

Kalyan Kodali (“KK”), President, Insurance & Healthcare, said “Jim’s wealth of experience and industry knowledge has already made him a key addition to the ValueMomentum family. His insights and perspectives as a carrier executive will be leveraged by our Insurance teams to better understand customer side issues, risks and expectations in initiatives focused on improving front office operations. Jim will not only lead our business development efforts, but will also contribute to strategic initiatives that will propel our growth in coming years. We look forward to his contribution and leadership as we position ValueMomentum for growth in North America.”

Valuemomentum, Inc., an insurance focused software and services provider, today announced James River Insurance’s successful deployment ofiFoundry Rating Enginewith out-of-the-box ISO Electronic Rating Content for commercial lines. James River can now keep up-to-date with ISO leveraging iFoundry and ISO Electronic Rating Content in 50 States. ISO is a Verisk Analytics (Nasdaq:VRSK) business. James River Insurance is also benefiting from online commercial lines rate and quote, by using iFoundry Rating Engine in combination with ValueMomentum’s DealFoundry Express – a solution that supports quoting for ISO lines by insurers’ internal staff as well as by retail agents.

“Through ease of import for ISO Electronic Rating Content, iFoundry Rating Engine has saved our team time and effort in interpreting ISO releases. Our team can now visually identify elements that have changed from one release to another, and can take actions in a much more efficient manner,” said Adarsh Singh, assistant vice president, information technology, James River Insurance Group. “The ease of use and configurability of the solution has also made it easy for our business analysts to implement our company specific deviations on top of the base ISO models,” he added.

iFoundry Rating Engine via its integration with ISO Electronic Rating Content allows insurers to launch new lines faster and automatically keep up to date with ISO releases”, said Jim Carlucci, Vice President, Insurance at ValueMomentum. “iFoundry also provides the flexibility to implement company specific deviations from ISO base rating factors and rules. This brings an unprecedented level of control and self-sufficiency to the carrier.”

ISO has long been a leading source of information for property/casualty insurance risk. “ISO congratulates ValueMomentum on the successful roll out of iFoundry at James River,” said Mark Sheehan, assistant vice president, ISO. “We’re delighted to see more carriers like James River Insurance use ISO Electronic Rating Content to its optimal potential through partners such as ValueMomentum.”

“Adoption of automated ISO updates is on the rise and it is delivering significant benefits to carriers”, states industry analyst Martina Conlon of Novarica. “In our recent research, carriers reported 59 percent savings in system modifications, 35 percent savings in cost, and a seven-month improvement in keeping up to date when using electronic ISO updated for complex circulars.”

ValueMomentum has invested in making ISO Electronic Rating Content available out-of-the-box with iFoundry for General Liability, Commercial Auto, Commercial Property, Business Owners Policy, Commercial Inland Marine and Crime.
About ValueMomentum

ValueMomentum provides Software & Services to Insurance, Financial Services and Health Payer firms. Our Customers like working with us because we deliver value to their initiatives, thereby, driving their momentum. ValueMomentum does this by applying a time-tested formula of combining strong technology expertise with deep industry experience.
ValueMomentum’s Software for Insurance Carriers includes iFoundry™ Rating Engine, iFoundry™ Product Configurator, DealFoundry™ Underwriting and Portal and BizDynamics™ for Microsoft Dynamics CRM.
About James River Insurance Company

James River Insurance Company operates as an Excess & Surplus carrier in all 50 states plus Washington, DC since 2003. The home office for James River Insurance Company (JRIC) is located in Richmond, VA. We have smaller, satellite underwriting offices in Atlanta, GA and Scottsdale, AZ. The holding company for JRIC, James River Group, Inc. is located in Raleigh, North Carolina. The ultimate parent of James River Group is Franklin Holdings (Bermuda), Ltd. located in Hamilton, Bermuda a private investor group led by D.E Shaw Group including Goldman Sachs and several others. A.M. Best Co. assigned an initial rating of A- (Excellent) Financial Size VI to James River Insurance Company in July 2003 and has affirmed it A- (Excellent) rating each year since. James River Insurance Company distributes its products through a relatively limited number of primarily wholesale brokers nationwide. The company writes brokerage, individual risk business through its various underwriting divisions – each organized around a specific industry group or coverage.
About ISO

Since 1971, ISO has been a leading source of information about property/casualty insurance risk. For a broad spectrum of commercial and personal lines of insurance, ISO provides statistical, actuarial, underwriting, and claims information and analytics; compliance and fraud identification tools; policy language; information about specific locations; and technical services. ISO serves insurers, reinsurers, agents and brokers, insurance regulators, risk managers, and other participants in the property/casualty insurance marketplace. Piscataway, NJ

ValueMomentum, Inc., a leading provider for software and services to Insurance firms, reported key momentum over the past year with over 15 new customer wins, record 30% revenue growth and 23% increase in employee ranks. A three-pronged execution along the lines of new customer wins, achieving high scores in customer satisfaction from existing client engagements resulting in more deals from these clients and bolstering innovation across ValueMomentum’s offerings drove this growth.

Raj Samanthapudi, ValueMomentum CEO explains “Our current levels of achievement and growth, including what we’ve seen in the past year alone, prove that companies are recognizing the value of our commitment to innovation across our offerings and our customer-first culture. We are extremely excited to see what 2017 will bring in terms of success, for both our newly signed customers and our existing client base.”
Customer Wins

ValueMomentum continued to expand its customer base with the addition of new customers across multiple tiers in the insurance industry and posted an all-time high win rate for new clients in a single year. ValueMomentum’s offerings span solutions that enable digital engagement, product innovation and services for automating operations.

ValueMomentum reported eight client wins from solutions for digital engagement and product innovation including Illinois Casualty and Frederick Mutual Insurance Company, amongst others. In addition, ValueMomentum reported seven client wins for services for automating operations, including Acuity Insurance, CapSpecialty and MMG Insurance.
Customer Engagement

In addition to new customer wins, ValueMomentum also experienced significant growth with existing customers, with new wins spanning digital engagement & product innovation solutions, core system or industry application services, cloud services, data sciences and DevOps. Customer satisfaction scored consistently high across its customer base resulting in 100% customer retention and referrals to new clients.
Innovation

ValueMomentum continues to invest heavily in innovation across its solutions and services. In 2016, ValueMomentum launchedBizDynamicsandApp2Datato enable insurers to digitally engage customers, agents and employees.  The company also bolstered its investments iniFoundry Rating EngineandiFoundry Product Lifecycle Management solutions.  These included expanding support fordigitally delivering ISO content, providing insurers with sophisticated change management capabilities to visually identify changes between their current and proposed changes and its impact on their book of business.

Similar investments in services to automate operations include the launch of its digital & cloud services to enable customers drive agility & innovation while improving operational efficiency. The company also increased its investments in data science services including developing a competency on an operational and transactional enterprise NoSQL database.

The combined effect of this 3-pronged execution across new client acquisition, client engagement success and innovation has helped deliver over 30% revenue growth and an 23% increase in the employee ranks.
About ValueMomentum

ValueMomentum provides software and services to Insurance, Healthcare & Financial Services firms. Customers choose ValueMomentum due to the company’s track record of delivering value and driving the momentum of customers’ business initiatives. ValueMomentum accomplishes this by applying a time-tested formula of combining strong technology expertise with deep industry experience. For more information, visithttps://www.valuemomentum.com.

South Plainfield, NJ

Novarica Analyst Karlyn Carnahan, Farmers Alliance Insurance CIO Andy Edwardson and Rating Systems Manager Rick Kohl joined ValueMomentum’s Anant Iyer, in an informative webinar to discuss key trends and strategies for Insurance rating and product innovation.

“Modifying products is a critical aspect of any mechanism for growth and doing that quickly, is a capability that carriers are looking for,” said Novarica Analyst Karlyn Carnahan. Karlyn noted competitive trends and growth imperatives faced by carriers and options available to carriers vis-a-vis product and rating, in a presentation packed with valuable insights and data.

Andy Edwardson, CIO of McPherson, Kansas-based Farmers Alliance and Rick Kohl, Rating Systems Manager discussed Farmers Alliance’s journey to transform a lengthy process of programming-led product changes to empowering rating analysts with tools to make rapid changes and additions to their product and pricing. “Our goal was to try to align systems with the business and emphasize the need for product changes, create a nimble environment where we could increase the speed-to-market,” said Andy Edwardson. “It now takes about one person a couple of weeks or less to rollout additional states for new products,” noted Rick Kohl.

Anant Iyer, Head of Product Management for ValueMomentum, including its iFoundry products, shared capabilities carriers are enabling across different phases of the product development lifecycle. “Carriers are seeking to manage deployments of their products in a much more fine grained way,” said Anant Iyer.
Webinar participants engaged the panelists with a questions and answers session following the presentation.
The webinar was sponsored by ValueMomentum, makers of iFoundry Rating Engine and Product Configurator.

paragraphs: HomeNews CenterPress ReleasesValueMomentum achieves SAS 70 Type II Certification
Related
Rigorous Certification by Leading Auditing Firm Affirms ValueMomentum’s High Quality Operational Standards and Controls.”

SAS 70, or Statement on Auditing Standard, is an internationally recognized auditing standard developed and maintained by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) and is awarded to service organizations that have implemented stringent internal controls.

The SAS 70 audit provides details of the Company’s control environment, including controls of information technology (IT) and operations. The IT controls focus on the areas of system and logical access, backup and recovery, system and application change management, and job scheduling. ValueMomentum’s systems and processes successfully comply with this globally recognized standard, SAS 70/SSAE 16 Type 1, accredited by PCAOBUS registered independent CPA. The scope involves the onsite-offshore model engagements involving remote development, remote testing and remote maintenance projects, based on sophisticated infrastructure.

This accreditation is a testimony of ValueMomentum’s delivery mechanism based on business requirements, level of transparency and the capability of establishing controls using advanced infrastructure, and thus complying with the client specified control objectives. With this compliance, ValueMomentum not only assures value for services for the client, but also understands and implements the client requirements on information security and intellectual property protection of client data on continuous basis.
About ValueMomentum

ValueMomentum is helping Insurance and Financial Services firms realize the full potential of their technology investments. An unmatched mix of Industry Process Experience, Technology Expertise and Keep-Customer-for-Life approach are the hallmarks of its solutions and services.

Headquartered in South Plainfield, NJ, ValueMomentum has world class delivery centers in South Plainfield, NJ and Hyderabad, India. There are additional Client Services and Business Development offices in Chicago, IL, Sunnyvale, CA and Hyderabad, India.

This will enable digital engagement for agents/brokers, underwriters and internal staff.
Looking for operational efficiencies to be easy to do business with and to drive more efficiencies, RMS HG’s primary business drivers were:

During the evaluation of available solutions, RMS HG determined ValueMomentum’s functionality coupled with an affordable cloud-based subscription plan made it a top contender with RMS HG’s selecting the solution in April 2016. Now in production with its hospitality program, RMS HG’s 15-week implementation was both on-time and on-budget.

Agents now enter the data in ValueMomentum’s BizDynamics solution from  a variety of devices.  Underwriters can do comparative rating and secure rates quickly.  What used to take approximately a week to, rate / quote / bind transactions now take less than a day.

Ryan A. Young, Executive Vice President/Director of Programs, RMS, is spearheading their position of making RMS the company ‘easy to do business with’ and meet its aggressive growth plans. “From the first introduction to ValueMomentum, we felt that the system was the best and most economical solution for RMS HG. PISCATAWAY, NJ: October 25, 2023 — ValueMomentum, a leading provider of IT services and solutions to the insurance industry, today announced that it has achieved the Guidewire PartnerConnect specializations: Guidewire PolicyCenter AMER and Guidewire Technical Upgrades. ValueMomentum is a Guidewire PartnerConnect Consulting partner at the Select level. With these achievements, ValueMomentum has now earned a total of six Guidewire PartnerConnect specializations.

Specializations are both regionally and globally based and require partners to demonstrate skills, knowledge, and competency in a particular Guidewire product or solution area. The achievement of specializations enables insurers to have more clarity and insight into which partners have proven capabilities in a region. In addition, partners with specializations can better promote their capabilities across Guidewire products and solutions.

“We congratulate ValueMomentum on achieving the Guidewire PolicyCenter AMER and Guidewire Technical Upgrades. We are pleased to recognize their expertise and proven capabilities and look forward to continuing our work together to contribute to the success of our mutual customers,” said Molly Black, Senior Director, Partner Programs and Enablement, Guidewire Software.

“As a Guidewire PartnerConnect Consulting partner, achieving these specializations strengthens our relationship with Guidewire and reflects the trust our customers have bestowed upon us. This will further augment our efforts to leverage Guidewire Cloud for core modernization and greenfield implementations,” said Naren Sivakumar, Vice President, ValueMomentum. “These specializations demonstrate ValueMomentum’s commitment to excellence and our position as a leading P&C-focused insurance solutions provider in North America.”

South Plainfield, NJ /PRNewswire/–

ValueMomentum, Inc., a Software & Services firm serving Insurance Carriers, today joined Capital Insurance Group® (CIG), the leading regional property and casualty insurer serving the Western United States Since 1898, in a session at the 2013 ACORD LOMA Forum, in Las Vegas, NV. The session, titled, “Enabling Underwriting Collaboration Using Portals” presented Capital Insurance Group’s use of ValueMomentum’s DealFoundry Underwriting & Portal.

The session was led by Capital Insurance Group CIO, David Todd and Commercial Product Manager, Ryan Bayne, where they shared the business objectives and the solution they selected. They outlined their objectives of providing a consistent work process to underwriters and enabling them to work remotely, their need to respond to market opportunities with a system where underwriting rules could be configured and deployed rapidly, and their goal of aiding underwriter-agent collaboration. They went on to describe how they conceived of the solution “VIEWS” – Virtual Integrated Electronic Workflow System, to meet their business goals.

Rajesh Narayan, General Manager and Head of P&C for ValueMomentum joined the discussion and introduced ValueMomentum’s DealFoundry™ Underwriting and Portal, a next-generation solution that allows underwriters to optimally utilize their experience and time, ultimately driving profitable growth. He further discussed how DealFoundry was successfully implemented at Capital Insurance Group.

“This initiative has met our objective of improving underwriter and agent productivity with collaborative underwriting technology, to drive profitable growth”, said David Todd, CIO, Capital Insurance Group”.

“Our goal is to write about 40% of BOP business straight through, and this platform allows us to continuously improve key workflow metrics”, said Ryan Bayne, Commercial Product Manager, Capital Insurance Group.

Rajesh Narayan, General Manager and Head of Property & Casualty at ValueMomentum said “Underwriters need a specialized system like DealFoundry, that helps them optimally utilize their experience and time, and to collaborate with agents to close deals”.
The session was well received, and an engaged audience posed business and technology questions to the speakers, while sharing comments.
About ValueMomentum

ValueMomentum provides Technology Services & Business Software to Insurance, Financial Services and Health Payor firms. Our Customers like working with us because we deliver value to their initiatives, thereby, driving their momentum. ValueMomentum does this by applying a time-tested formula of combining strong technology expertise with deep industry experience.
ValueMomentum’s software for Insurance Carriers includes iFoundry Rating Engine, iFoundry Product Configurator and DealFoundry Underwriting and Portal.

Related
South Plainfield, NJ

ValueMomentum, a global provider of Technology Services and Pre-packaged Products to Insurance, Healthcare and Financial Services firms, today announced the company has been recognized with the 2012 Insurance RAVE Award in the Service category. The Insurance IT RAVE Awards are co-sponsored by insurance industry analyst firm, Novarica, and the Summit Business Media Insurance technology publication, Tech Decisions, and are based on scores achieved in Novarica’s Average Customer Experience (ACE) Rankings.

The Novarica ACE Ranking Report™, based on online survey responses from senior technology and operational executives at Insurance Carriers engaging ValueMomentum as an IT Services Provider, gave ValueMomentum a score of 99 out of a possible 100 for Overall Customer Satisfaction, and 98 each for functionality and organization, resulting in an overall score of 98.

“ValueMomentum’s clients are clearly enthusiastic about the value they deliver”, said Matthew Josefowicz, Partner & Managing Director of Novarica, a widely published and often-cited expert on Insurance Technology, operations and e-business issues, adding, “this award is a recognition of their strong performance and focus on creating customer value”.

“Technology solutions involve a true partnership between carriers and providers,” says James Daggett, publisher of Tech Decisions. “Customers have spoken loud and clear – ValueMomentum offers superb service and value. Congratulations on receiving the highest score in Service for your technology services.”

“We are honoured to win the 2012 RAVE Award and are grateful for our customers’ patronage”, said Kalyan Kodali, President of ValueMomentum’s Insurance & Life Sciences Division, adding, “We are committed to meeting and exceeding our customers’ expectations, by applying a proven formula of combining technology expertise with deep insurance line-of-business, transaction and regulatory experience by our staff – at all levels”.
ValueMomentum’s Technology Services include Quality Assurance, Business Intelligence, SharePoint-based development, Enterprise Content Management and Application Development & Management.
In addition, ValueMomentum offers Insurance Carriers iFoundry Rating, Product & Rules Platform and DealFoundry Underwriting & Portal.

ValueMomentum provides Technology Services & Business Software to Insurance, Financial Services and Health Payor firms. Our Customers like working with us because we deliver value to their initiatives, thereby, driving their momentum. Headquartered in South Plainfield, NJ, ValueMomentum has world class delivery centers in South Plainfield, NJ and Hyderabad, India. There are additional Client Services and Business Development offices in Chicago, IL, Sunnyvale, CA and Hyderabad, India.

ValueMomentum Inc., a provider of software and services to insurance carriers, health payers and the broader financial services industry, today announced that it has partnered withSmart Communications™, the leading cloud-based platform for enterprise customer communications.

Related

Valuemomentum, Inc., a provider of software and services to insurance carriers, today announced that iFoundry™ Rating Engine is now available for rating with ISO Electronic Rating Content (ERC) for commercial lines, including General Liability, Commercial Auto, Business Owners Policy, Commercial Property, Inland Marine, and Crime. ISO is a member of the Verisk Insurance Solutions group at Verisk Analytics (Nasdaq:VRSK).

ValueMomentum had initially announced the integration of ISO Electronic Rating Content with its iFoundry Rating Engine product in October 2013. A recent Novarica Research Partners Program report, titled “ISO Support: A Comparison of Manual and Electronic Practices” and underwritten by ISO, revealed significant improvements in time to market and costs when using an electronic process:

Chad Hersh, managing director at Novarica, said, “Using an electronic process reduces the cost for complex circulars by 38 percent. The biggest cost savings is in loading the changes into the system. Carriers report an average savings of 59 percent when using electronic means on complex circulars,” adding, “Rating solutions with comprehensive support for ISO Electronic Rating Content can significantly accelerate time to market, reduce premium leakage, and lower costs.”

Kevin Thompson, president of Insurance Programs and Analytic Services at ISO, said, “We’re pleased to note ValueMomentum’s commitment to the ISO Electronic Rating Content Associate Program. Availability of out-of-the-box rating for most Commercial Lines with ISO Electronic Rating Content provides good options for our common customers.”

Kalyan Kodali (“KK”), ValueMomentum’s president of Insurance & Healthcare, said, “Out-of-the-box rating availability for commercial lines using ISO Electronic Rating Content is noteworthy, since property and casualty carriers and MGAs that leverage ISO content for these lines will now have the unprecedented ability to launch new products and enter new markets instantly, while significantly increasing productivity and time-tomarket for maintaining rates, rules and forms.”
About ValueMomentum

ValueMomentum provides Software & Services to Insurance, Financial Services and Health Payer firms. Our Customers like working with us because we deliver value to their initiatives, thereby, driving their momentum. ValueMomentum does this by applying a time-tested formula of combining strong technology expertise with deep industry experience.
ValueMomentum’s Software for Insurance Carriers includes iFoundry™ Rating Engine, iFoundry™ Product Configurator and DealFoundry™ Underwriting and Portal.
